items.text: Patriots will likely activate WR AJ Brown off IR to play vs. Jets Sunday after limited practice all week (high-ankle sprain from opener). Listed QUESTIONABLE but anticipated return.
items.why: Practiced limited all week; sources say activation expected.
items.implication: Major boost for NE offense/Drake Maye; Brown starter if active. Levitan notes status still unclear as of Fri night.
items.opportunity: High target share return; reverse any prior beneficiary spikes for other NE WRs.
items.conflict: Levitan: unclear on Q as of Fri; Berry optimistic on possible return.

items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; remains sidelined indefinitely with superficial blood clot in calf. First game without him; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; info gathering continues, no IR plans per sources with Rapoport.
items.implication: McKee starts behind makeshift line; low PHI implied total (~17.75). Healthy top-4 pass-catchers (Smith/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) available.
items.opportunity: Volume to DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Dontayvion Wicks in pass game; McKee streaming QB consideration.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT again (ankle) for Ravens Week 6; second straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts.
items.why: Ankle; no practice this week despite earlier return hopes.
items.implication: Downgrade to BAL pass game; Zay Flowers still WR2 viable, Mark Andrews benchable.
items.opportunity: Huntley game script may elevate checkdowns; Flowers volume stable.

items.text: Eagles officially ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday vs. Panthers; second straight miss. Will Shipley also OUT (foot/IR).
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 4; no practice this week.
items.implication: PHI backfield to Dameon Pierce as lead (4th-string previously); thin RB room with Bigsby/Shipley out.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share for remaining RBs vs. soft CAR run D; pass-catchers elevated with McKee.

items.text: On ETR report: Unclear Qs on AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Probable-leaning: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf (illness), Chris Olave (illness), Rico Dowdle. PIT thin WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) = heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce.
items.why: Practice participation + report tags; PIT depth chart; PHI personnel.
items.implication: Metcalf heavy usage; PHI pass-catchers viable with McKee; monitor Brown/Henderson closely; Warren risk.
items.opportunity: PIT 2-WR sets boost Metcalf routes/targets; PHI WR/TE opportunity despite thin RB.
items.conflict: Brown status still fluid vs. Rapoport likely-play reports.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Jets Week 6 along with AD Mitchell.
items.implication: Jets RB committee/backup elevation vs. NE.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) for Chiefs Week 6; Tyquan Thornton also OUT. Bye insufficient for recovery.
items.implication: Mahomes targets redistribute to Xavier Worthy and others vs. LAC.
items.opportunity: Worthy upside WR3; secondary WRs flex.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin); not traveling to London. Woody Marks leads Texans backfield.
items.implication: Marks as lead vs. strong JAC run D but PPR receiving upside.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love OUT (ankle) for Cardinals; rest of week off, run-down.
items.implication: ARI RB elevation in tough matchup; may chase score.
items.opportunity: Backup RB flex if receiving work.

items.text: DeVonta Smith IN/cleared (removed from report) after prior hamstring/toe issues; returns with Hurts/Saquon out.
items.implication: Borderline WR2 with McKee; top pass-catcher healthy alongside Goedert/Wicks.
items.opportunity: Primary target share in depleted PHI offense.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (high-ankle sprain) QUESTIONABLE; practiced but surprised he could; NE plays Thursday next so may be availability test. Rhamondre elevated if out. Levitan: unclear.
items.implication: Stevenson top-12/18 either way; avoid Henderson if plays through it.

items.text: Ladd McConkey and Quentin Johnston IN/cleared off injury report for Chargers.
items.implication: Herbert gets weapons back; McConkey WR3/top-12 upside if 100%.

items.text: Berry LOVES RBs Kyren Williams (vs ARI, elite usage), Javonte Williams (@GB, goal-line role), Rhamondre Stevenson (vs NYJ, volume vs leaky run D). Also loves Drake London (vs CHI), Mike Evans/George Kittle (vs WSH buffet D), Brock Purdy/Stafford/Jordan Love (high-scoring spots).
items.why: Volume, matchups (run Ds leaking or pass Ds soft), roles/goal-line, game environments.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Kyren RB5 range, etc.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target shares in favorable spots.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA tough), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT, low feed), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI, shaky QB/usage), J.K. Dobbins (vs SEA run D), Bo Nix (toughest pass D), Justin Herbert (low total/scoring rut).
items.why: Ugly matchups, low target/feed trends, QB/team total issues.
items.conflict: McConkey/Johnston clearance may help Herbert slightly but overall fade stands.
